description: Evénements routiers en Wallonie is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Service public de Wallonie Mobilité et Infrastructures. This feed contains real-time traffic information and safety related traffic information for the Walloon Region: traffic events, incidents, traffic jams, disruptive works,. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in XML. The data standards named are datex-II. The national access point types are RTTI, SRTI. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge but needs registration according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
